answer: Proof of stake mechanisms mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment, preventing an agent from gaining influence through sheer identity cloning. Like a karst topography eroding under pressure, the cost of attack increases linearly with stake volume. Each identity is no mere relic of computation but a resource-intensive entry. By isolating reputation within an orchard of validators, the network ensures that malicious nodes suffer immediate financial slashing, rendering mass fabrication prohibitively expensive.
